_comment: Which of the game's monster variant tables each of our monsters is.
`fiddle/monsters/*.toml` declares 36 variants across 12 family files; this
dataset ships 35 monsters named from the wiki's bestiary pages. The two
vocabularies almost rhyme — the game writes the colour as a suffix
(`rockclod_blue`) where the wiki writes it as a prefix (Blue Clod) — but the
base variant of each family carries no colour at all, and only a human
reading both drop tables can say that the game's bare `mushroom` is the
wiki's Red Mushroom.
Every base-colour call below was verified two ways: the variant's drop table
against the wiki's per-colour drop table (mushroom drops Red Toadstool,
stalagmite drops Copper Ore like the wiki's blue one), and the hp
progression against the wiki's biome order (each family's bare variant is
its shallowest, weakest form).
`sapling_orange_mini` is deliberately unmapped: the small saplings the
orange one splits into mid-fight, part of the same encounter, not a
bestiary entry of its own.
One known source disagreement rides on this mapping: the wiki's Purple Clod
drop table claims Mistril Ore, but the game's `rockclod_purple` drops stone
— the wiki page seems to have copied the Mistril Clod's table. The game
wins on drops, per the precedence rule.
